title: fix(app-shell,components): resolve a page's inline locale label and description to the viewer's language (objectui#13488)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DRqbNi4iARYYtqZmwLSPhaR)_

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

Fixes #13488
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

`PageSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` types a page's `label` and `description` as `I18nLabel`, so an inline locale map such as `{ 'zh-CN', en }` is valid metadata, and the `/meta` read serves it unchanged. Two packages drew it raw on a page route, and React refused the object as a child (error #31), so the route was blank for every viewer:

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `AppHeader`'s page branch.** It handed the served label to `pageLabel` as its fallback, and `pageLabel` returns an unmatched fallback untouched, so the map became the phone bar's title. It now resolves through `metadataText` in the viewer's language (`useObjectTranslation().language`), the call the report branch has used since objectui#13470, and still passes through the `pages.NAME.label` bundle lookup. The humanized slug stays the fallback when no label resolves.
- **`@object-ui/components`, `PageRenderer`.** The page's own implicit heading (`schema.title ?? schema.label`), the line under it (`schema.description`), and the description it hands a titled `page:header` through `PageDescriptionContext` were all drawn raw. Each now resolves through `pickLocalized` in the viewer's language, the resolver `page:header` already uses for its own title in the same package. With only the app bar fixed, an `app`, `home` or `utility` page with a map label stayed blank through this heading (measured, below), so the claim was widened to this file (claim amendment on #13488).
- **Swept, same file, same call:** `AppHeader`'s dashboard branch drew a served dashboard label straight into the phone bar's title. `DashboardSchema.label` is `I18nLabel` too, so it is now `metadataText(…) ?? dashboardLabel(…)`.

A plain-string label or description draws exactly as before: `metadataText` and `pickLocalized` both pass a string through, and an empty one still falls to the slug or hides the description. Studio's page previews (`SourcePageEditor`, `PagePreview`) render through the same `PageRenderer`, so they get the fix too. One changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/components` patch.

## Tests

New pins, each mounting the real component under a real `I18nProvider`, each leg in `en` and `zh-CN` reading different strings out of one map, with plain strings as the control:

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.pageDashboardTitleInlineLocale-13488.test.tsx`: the `AppHeader.reportCrumbInlineLocale-13470` harness with `useObjectLabel` real. Legs `PAGE_LABEL_MAP_RESOLVES`, `DASHBOARD_LABEL_MAP_RESOLVES`, two `PLAIN_STRING_CONTROL`s.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-inline-locale-label-13488.test.tsx`: an `app` page through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `PageRenderer`. Legs `HEADING_MAP_RESOLVES`, `DESCRIPTION_MAP_RESOLVES`, `HEADER_DESCRIPTION_MAP_RESOLVES` (titled `page:header`), `PLAIN_STRING_CONTROL`.

Readings, final head `2c82e03` unless stated:

- The two new files: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 16 passed (16).
- Every test file that names `AppHeader`, `PageView`, `PageRenderer`, `SourcePageEditor`, `PagePreview` or `pageKindNode`, plus every `packages/components` test that names `PageRenderer`, `page:header`, `pageType`, the page renderer module or an `app`/`home`/`utility` page node (212 files, found by `git grep -lE` over test files), with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 212 passed (212), Tests 2161 passed (2161). Run at `bf37518`; the only later commit, `2c82e03`, changes the type annotation of one new test's fixture, and both new files were re-run at `2c82e03` above.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/components --concurrency=2 --continue`: 31 successful, 31 total. Both packages' `type-check` chain `tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test files are type-checked.
- eslint on the five touched files: 0 errors. Every warning is on a line this PR does not add; the one on a changed line in `page.tsx` is the `(schema as any).label` read the old line already had.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: pass (4 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset). `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: pass. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

Narrowed, declared: the whole `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/components/` suites were not run locally; CI's sharded `pnpm test` runs them. The narrowed set's blind spot is a test that mounts these components through another import path without naming them.

Probe before the fix, on main `85b6a48`, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `PageRenderer` (a throwaway file, not committed): an `app` page with a map `label`, one with a map `description`, and one with a titled `page:header` and a map `description` all failed on `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {zh-CN, en})`.

Ablation, one site at a time on the committed fix, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit once, blob must change, restore proven by blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`), running the two new files each time:

- page branch reverted (`pageDef?.label || humanizeSlug(pageName)`): 2 failed, 14 passed. Only `PAGE_LABEL_MAP_RESOLVES` fails, in both languages, on React error #31.
- dashboard branch reverted (`dashboardDef?.label || dashboardLabel(…)`): 2 failed, 14 passed. Only `DASHBOARD_LABEL_MAP_RESOLVES` fails, on the same error.
- `PageRenderer` heading reverted (`schema.title ?? schema.label` raw): 2 failed, 14 passed. Only `HEADING_MAP_RESOLVES` fails, on the same error.
- `PageRenderer` description reverted (raw `schema.description`): 4 failed, 12 passed. `DESCRIPTION_MAP_RESOLVES` and `HEADER_DESCRIPTION_MAP_RESOLVES` fail, on the same error.

## Acceptance notes

- `InterfaceListPage` (an interface page's list surface) reads `typeof page.label === 'string' ? page.label : page.name` for its heading and its record drawer's title, and draws `page.description` only when it is a string. A page with a map label does not blank there, but it shows the page's machine name instead of its label, and a map description is not shown. Read from the code on `85b6a48`, not measured; outside this claim's file surface. Handed to the seat.
- `AppHeader`'s view branch hands `viewDef?.label || viewDef?.title` to `viewTabLabel`, and a list view's `label` is `I18nLabel` in the spec as well. The object page's tab bar (`ObjectView`) hands the same label to the same function, so whether a map view label blanks a view route is a question about `ObjectView`, not this header alone. Read from the code, not measured; not changed here.
- The page's phone-bar title still passes the resolved label through the `pages.NAME.label` bundle lookup, while the page's own heading draws the served label. That split predates this PR and is unchanged, as on the report route.
